title: Chapter Two
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 1 Numbered Discourses 1.198–208

15. Dutiyavagga Chapter Two

“Etadaggaṁ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṁ bhikkhūnaṁ manomayaṁ kāyaṁ abhinimminantānaṁ yadidaṁ cūḷapanthako. “The foremost of my monk disciples in creating a mind-made body is Cūḷapanthaka.”

… Cetovivaṭṭakusalānaṁ yadidaṁ cūḷapanthako. “… who are skilled in the turning away of the mind is Cūḷapanthaka.”

… Saññāvivaṭṭakusalānaṁ yadidaṁ mahāpanthako. “… who are skilled in the turning away through perception is Mahāpanthaka.”

… Araṇavihārīnaṁ yadidaṁ subhūti. “… who live without strife is Subhūti.”

… Dakkhiṇeyyānaṁ yadidaṁ subhūti. “… who are worthy of a religious donation is Subhūti.”

… Āraññakānaṁ yadidaṁ revato khadiravaniyo. “… who stay in the wilderness is Revata of the Acacia Wood.”

… Jhāyīnaṁ yadidaṁ kaṅkhārevato. “… who practice absorption is Revata the Doubter.”

… Āraddhavīriyānaṁ yadidaṁ soṇo koḷiviso. “… who are energetic is Soṇa Koḷivisa.”

… Kalyāṇavākkaraṇānaṁ yadidaṁ soṇo kuṭikaṇṇo. “… who enunciate well is Soṇa of the Sharp Ears.”

… Lābhīnaṁ yadidaṁ sīvali. “… who receive many possessions is Sīvali.”

… Saddhādhimuttānaṁ yadidaṁ vakkalī”ti. “… who are committed to faith is Vakkalī.”

Vaggo dutiyo.
